name: Sortie
detailed_description:
Survive. Hunt. Dominate.

Step into a brutal, post-collapse open world where every encounter could be your last. In this hardcore PvP multiplayer survival game, you’ll scavenge for supplies, craft weapons, and outwit both the dead and the living in an unforgiving landscape teeming with danger.

Whether you're a lone wolf or part of a ruthless squad, trust is rare and betrayal is common. Engage in tense firefights, ambush other survivors, or trade and form uneasy alliances — the choice is yours. But remember: in this world, mercy can be fatal.

Key Features:

  • Persistent Open World: Explore a dynamic map filled with abandoned towns, military zones, and hidden stashes.

  • Full Loot PvP: Kill or be killed. Everything your enemy carries can be yours — if you can survive the fight.

  • Survival Mechanics: Manage hunger, thirst, injuries, and infections. Adapt or die.

  • Base Building: Fortify hideouts, set traps, and defend your loot from raiders.

  • Dynamic Weather & Day/Night Cycle: Plan your strategies around harsh weather and pitch-black nights.

  • Organic Storytelling: No scripted missions — your story is forged by player interactions, choices, and consequences.

If you’re looking for a high-stakes, adrenaline-fueled survival experience where every bullet counts and every decision matters — this is your battleground.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U / AMD Ryzen 5 5500 or better
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD is highly recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3800XT or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6600 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD is highly recommended
